BIBLIOGRAPHIC RECORD

Augustin S. Macdonald, comp.  A Collection of Verse by California Poets.  1914.

By Mark Twain

Lines

On His Wife’s Tombstone
W
ARM
 summer sun,
Shine kindly here.
Warm southern wind,
Blow softly here.
Green sod above,
Lie light, lie light.
Good night, dear heart,
Good night, good night.
